title: When the Wreck Breaks
author: Marguerite Nakamura
blurb: Orsen Ravensworth, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must cross the range ahead of the snows before the glacier calving season opens the route — briefly.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
